verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a developer-facing conversion API, so agent-oriented docs are a fair question for it. Direct probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The human-oriented HTML docs and SDKs are not agent-oriented docs and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
